name: Motives: The Ultimate Problem
source:
Top detectives from all over the world are gathered to solve the ultimate world-threatening mystery. Examine clues and piece together deductions in this thrilling visual novel — a direct sequel to Methods: The Detective Competition.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3736370]Steam[/url]]
